rules.ranging: D2 statistical ranging: near-circular orbit (speed 0.8-1.2 x circular, flight-path angle <= 12 deg), inclination <= 30 deg, SPHEREx's real position; 95% region (delta chi2 6.18); position error 0.5 px or the track's own scatter; ranges wider than 30x reported as not constrained
rules.linking: candidate tracks 1-48 h apart joined when the jump matches their motion and brightness

3I_ATLAS_blind_test.mode: position only: no point claims the target; every reported point in this patch counts, and points away from the target count as false
3I_ATLAS_blind_test.note: a perfect detector finds 3I/ATLAS in the ~207 frames where it is visible (S/N >= 5): score_vs_visible_frames is the fair score

ceres_check.mode: position only: no point claims the target; every reported point in this patch counts, and points away from the target count as false

nep_note: No known asteroid crosses the North Ecliptic Pole patch: every candidate there is either a rare real object or a false alarm. Count them as the false-alarm test.
